metric.name: Terminology clarity, consistency, and definiteness
metric.text: Use one term per concept, define novel/technical terms, keep claims self‑consistent and technically sensible, and draft to give clear public notice; avoid coined/ambiguous phrasing and clean up sentence structure and references.
